{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders and refunded orders
valid_orders = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the number of valid orders
print(f'Number of valid orders (excluding QA and refunded): {len(valid_orders)}')

# Calculate conversion rate: proportion of valid orders that were converted
conversion_rate = valid_orders['converted'].mean()
print(f'Conversion rate (proportion): {conversion_rate}')

# Convert to percent
conversion_rate_percent = conversion_rate * 100
print(f'Conversion rate (percent): {conversion_rate_percent}')"}
